title: MysticBlocks WARZONE
description: The ultimate Minecraft military modpack with TACZ, SBW, advanced weapons, vehicles, and action-packed warfare
body:
# MysticBlocks Modern Warfare [TACZ] + [SBW]

Experience modern military warfare in Minecraft with a collection of powerful guns, vehicles, and combat-focused content.

### Included Mods

* **[TaCZ] Timeless and Classics Zero** with additional gun packs
* **Superb Warfare** featuring modern weapons, tanks, armored vehicles, helicopters, planes, and more
* Performance and optimization mods for improved FPS and smoother gameplay
* Resource packs to enhance visuals and immersion

### Features

* Hundreds of modern firearms and attachments
* Military vehicles including tanks, helicopters, aircraft, and transport vehicles
* Realistic combat and large-scale warfare gameplay
* Better performance through optimization mods
* Enhanced visuals with included resource packs

### Future Updates

More content, weapons, vehicles, gun packs, and gameplay improvements will be added in future updates as the modpack continues to grow.
